row.evidence: Datadog's Infrastructure pricing table checks SCIM for Pro and Enterprise (not Free), and the SCIM docs say "SCIM is available with the Infrastructure Pro, Infrastructure Enterprise, and Startup plans."
row.notes: Status changed gated -> free: SCIM is on Infrastructure Pro, the first paid tier above Free, with no upcharge (June's own row had multiplier 1.0). Pricing is per host ($15/host/mo annual, $18 on-demand; Enterprise $23), with unlimited user accounts, so per-user fields and the multiplier are now null (June's 15 per-user value dropped). SAML SSO also starts at Pro. Okta and Entra are the supported IdPs; Entra Team provisioning is blocked by a Microsoft app-update freeze and group mapping is unsupported, but users still provision. Deprovisioning disables users (they cannot be permanently removed).

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $15 per host per month billed annually ($18 on-demand)

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: $23 per host per month billed annually ($27 on-demand)
plans.notes: Adds Multiple SAML Providers and Governance Console.

auth.token_source: Organization settings > Application Keys (service account application key recommended)
auth.notes: Key tied to a user is revoked if that user is deprovisioned, breaking SCIM.

operations.notes: Group push creates Managed Teams (Okta). Teams via SCIM unavailable with Entra and 'only available for select organizations' per API reference.

deprovision.data_retained: Users cannot be permanently removed; disabled users keep authored dashboards/monitors and can be re-enabled.
deprovision.notes: Pricing is per host with unlimited user accounts, so seats are not a factor.

roles.how: SCIM 'roles' multi-valued attribute with Datadog role UUIDs (Okta profile attribute; Entra app roles via AppRoleAssignmentsComplex); unmatched roles fall back to the default role.

limitations.text: Only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID are explicitly supported.
Entra: Team provisioning via SCIM unavailable due to a Microsoft freeze; group mapping not supported. Users still provision.
SCIM team provisioning is limited to select organizations per the API reference.
Datadog recommends disabling SAML JIT when using SCIM.

scim.notes: Entra Tenant URL adds ?aadOptscim062020. Infrastructure Startup plan also includes SCIM. SSO is recommended, not required.

auth.notes: DD-API-KEY + DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers (application key of an admin) or OAuth apps with scopes.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit Trail events API (GET /api/v2/audit/events, POST /api/v2/audit/events/search); plan requirement not checked.

user_api.notes: Users API paths copied from the API reference. The pages loaded do not state which plan includes API access, so plan and api_tax are null.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Microsoft tutorial lists user create/remove/sync only; Team (group) provisioning unavailable.

google.notes: Datadog lists Google among SAML IdPs; no Google provisioning documented.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud documents a Datadog SSO connector; no SCIM described.

Whether SCIM DELETE disables or removes the user is not stated (API text says 'Delete the group with the given user_uuid', apparently a copy error); UI docs say users cannot be permanently removed.
Plan needed for the Users API and the Audit Trail events API is not stated.
